raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since batch 13 the new 'v2' collector writes txn_ts exactly 6 hours later than the true time. In the samples, v2 rows have txn_ids that fall between legacy rows 6 hours earlier (for example 12:04:07 sits next to legacy rows at about 06:04). The late-evening v2 rows therefore spill into 00:00-06:00 of the next day, which explains the 33-row 2026-01-19 and the 39 off-hours rows on 2026-01-18. Fix: shift v2 timestamps back 6 hours in silver_transactions, and the gold tables rebuild from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - (CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE INTERVAL 0 HOUR END) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - (CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE INTERVAL 0 HOUR END) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
